micah: Heads-up: scheduling a hot-swap (blue->green) for router-pool to roll out router:v3. Change window 2026-03-21 02:00-03:00 UTC. Requesting ops + SRE ack. Plan in short:
- deploy green (v3) with 0 weight
- smoke + kv/cache warmup (3m)
- incremental smooth ramp: 0 -> 5 -> 20 -> 50 -> 100 (10m between steps)
- session drain on blue, 30m grace
- automated rollback on error-rate or p95 breach
Release notes: https://go.redwood/release/2026-03-router-v3 (small changes: kernel selection tweak + kv-cache bump)
@deploy-bot please run preflight and post a checklist.

deploy-bot: Preflight OK: image registry.redwood/router:v3 exists, permissions OK, infra quota sufficient in eu-west1. Preflight checklist:
- images: ok
- infra headroom: ok
- canary tests queued (id: canary-20260321-17)
- deploy window reserved
Queueing canary run and will post results here. Use trafficctl for the ramp.

sofia: Ops ack with two requests:
1) enable cookie-pin-maintain during ramp: keep session-cookie pinned to origin for 45m after each step so sticky sessions don't bounce users mid-flow.
2) reserve 2 spare kgpu nodes in dedicated pool for warmup to avoid preemption during ramp. I've opened infra-ticket INF-3921 to lock capacity.

jamie: SRE checks: define hard thresholds for auto-rollback and for alarms:
- p95 latency baseline = 95ms, rollback if p95 > 250ms over 3m window
- 5xx error-rate baseline = 0.12%, rollback if > 0.8% over 3m
- increased tail CPU or OOM rate -> alert immediately
I also suggest a fast-stop circuit: if any upstream rate limiter trips in two regions, cut the ramp and shift back to blue. I'll attach temporary alert rule name: "router-hot-swap-guard"

kate: Added concrete trafficctl command for the run (we use this in the ops runbook). Please copy/paste in the deploy window when ready:
```
trafficctl shift --service router-pool --from blue --to green \n  --steps 0,5,20,50,100 --interval 600 --grace 1800 \n  --pin-sessions=true --smoothing=exponential --rollback-policy=auto
```
Notes: interval is seconds between steps (600s = 10m), grace is session drain in seconds (1800s = 30m). smoothing=exponential will do small micro-steps to avoid step jank.

micah: I'll pin the config and release notes now. Pinning router-config: v2026-03-21-001. Also enabling the "preemptive-fallback" flag set to green->blue on anomalies. Leaving a final checklist for the run: 
- [ ] infra ticket INF-3921 locked capacity
- [ ] deploy-bot green deployed with weight 0
- [ ] canary tests pass (canary-20260321-17)
- [ ] trafficctl scheduled with smoothing
- [ ] alerts wired (router-hot-swap-guard)
If everyone is :thumbsup: i'll kick at 02:00 UTC.

sofia: +1 on all. I also added a short maintenance note for support: please notify support channel 30m before start so CS can watch PDs.

jamie: +1, I'll be monitoring p95 & 5xx and on-call window 02:00-03:30. I'll escalate immediately if circuit trips.

micah: @deploy-bot please start scheduled job at 02:00 UTC. If deploy-bot posts smoke failure, we hold and manually inspect.

deploy-bot: Scheduled run created: job id rdeploy-4898765432-hot-swap. Canary start ETA 02:03 UTC. Will post canary results and step updates here. :robot_face:
